data.message: I propose 10 tons each this month: 25 × 10 = 250 caught, leaving 250, so either replenishment outcome restores the lake to 500. Repeating this gives each of us $10,000 monthly without exhausting the fishery. If stock ever falls below 500, scale requests down to preserve at least half. I intend to request 10 and invite everyone to support this sustainable plan.
